{{Quote|They were poor and without hope. Potential Rebel scum waiting to turn against the Empire. We were lucky to strike at them before they made a move against the colony.|[[Korvellen]]|<ref name="RES" />}}
The '''slaughter on Sarko VI''' was an event that occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarko VI]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Prelude==
Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], an informant provided the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] with false information regarding a supposed [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] cell on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarko VI]]. The Empire believed this information to be true and mounted an operation to flush out the Rebels, who were supposedly hiding on the outskirts of the main settlement.<ref name="RES" />

==The slaughter==
Imperial [[Troop/Legends|troops]], under the orders of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Korvellen]], descended on the location and slaughtered its residents. However, the residents turned out to be just harmless squatters who had run out of resources and were forced to live in ramshackle shelters and makeshift homes on the outskirts of the colony.<ref name="RES" />

==Aftermath==
Captain Korvellen later stated that he believed his actions were justifiable, as the squatters were impoverished and desperate, and thus potential recruits for the Rebellion.<ref name="RES" />
